tasks.title: Project Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Node.js backend and Vite+React+Tailwind frontend. Setup workspace structure. Versions: Vite 6+, React 19+, Tailwind 4+, Node 22+ (LTS).

tasks.title: Database Schema
tasks.description: Design and implement SQLite schema for storing machine inventory, status history, and system logs.

tasks.title: SSH Integration Layer
tasks.description: Implement a backend service using ssh2 or similar to query remote machines (Zeus, NAS, etc.) for CPU, Memory, Disk, and Logs using configured host keys.

tasks.title: API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create Express/Fastify endpoints to serve machine status data and trigger SSH polls.

tasks.title: Dashboard UI - Home
tasks.description: Build the main dashboard landing page with machine cards showing real-time (or cached) status metrics.

tasks.title: Verification: Project Setup
tasks.description: Run npm install in root and frontend, then verify vite.config.js exists and is correctly configured for 0.0.0.0.

tasks.title: Audit: Project Setup
tasks.description: Check that all required dependencies are in package.json and directory structure is sane.

tasks.title: Database Schema
tasks.description: Design and implement SQLite schema for storing machine inventory, status history, and system logs.

tasks.title: SSH Integration Layer
tasks.description: Implement a backend service using ssh2 or similar to query remote machines (Zeus, NAS, etc.) for CPU, Memory, Disk, and Logs using configured host keys.

tasks.title: API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create Express/Fastify endpoints to serve machine status data and trigger SSH polls.

tasks.title: Dashboard UI - Home
tasks.description: Build the main dashboard landing page with machine cards showing real-time (or cached) status metrics.

tasks.title: Smart Anomaly Detection
tasks.description: Implement lightweight statistical anomaly detection (e.g. Z-score) for CPU/RAM instead of static thresholds to reduce alert fatigue.

tasks.title: Docker Container Auto-Healing
tasks.description: Monitor container health checks and automatically restart unhealthy containers after a grace period. Includes configurable restart policies.

tasks.title: Predictive Capacity Planning
tasks.description: Analyze historical usage trends (linear regression) to forecast when disk/RAM will reach 100% capacity. Alert weeks in advance.

tasks.title: Mobile App Layout Refinement
tasks.description: Optimize the dashboard and metrics view for mobile screens. Ensure charts are responsive and cards wrap correctly. Add swipe-to-refresh hints.

tasks.title: Historical Uptime Visualization
tasks.description: Create a new chart in the Metrics tab specifically for visualizing machine uptime and downtime periods over the last 30 days.

tasks.title: User Documentation
tasks.description: Generate a README.md or a help section in the app explaining how to configure SSH keys and machine inventory.

tasks.title: Cluster-wide Aggregated Metrics
tasks.description: Implement a high-level summary view that aggregates CPU and RAM usage across all configured machines to show total cluster load.

tasks.title: Configurable Alert Webhooks
tasks.description: Add support for sending system alerts (offline machines, high load, unhealthy containers) to Discord or Telegram via webhooks.

tasks.title: Centralized Log Search
tasks.description: Implement a search and filter interface for the 'logs' table to allow users to quickly find events across all machines.

tasks.title: Unified Responsive Dashboard UI
tasks.description: Overhaul the frontend for a mobile-responsive interface using Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons. Sidebar/tabbed layout with System Stats, SSH Terminal, Container Management, and Notification settings. Dark sidebar, collapsible on desktop, bottom tab bar on mobile.

tasks.title: Terminal Backend Proxy
tasks.description: Implement a WebSocket-based SSH proxy using ws and ssh2 to enable the interactive terminal in the dashboard. Ensure it securely uses the configured SSH keys.
